address._note: Sent by the client (answers batch 5, 2026-09-18). ar/en are shown on the Contact card and in the footer; postal feeds the JSON-LD PostalAddress.

contact._mapNote: Dropped-pin link at the office coordinates (client, 2026-09-19); the earlier bare "?q=lat,lng" link resolved to a neighbouring business. Shown as the separate «عرض على الخريطة» / "View on map" link under the address (contact card and footer), and as hasMap in the JSON-LD.

structuredData._readme: JSON-LD on the home page. Emitted only when SITE_URL is set (production). The address is a PostalAddress built from contact.address.postal in the page language.

_domainNote: Custom domain elbasha-contracting.com since 2026-09-19 (the site launched on elbasha-contracting.pages.dev first). Informational only: the build reads the origin from the SITE_URL environment variable (https://elbasha-contracting.com in Cloudflare Pages). See docs/DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md §10.
